breakdown.description: Dittus–Boelter (turbulent) correlation is applied in the laminar regime (Re=800).
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the core inconsistency. The original prompt incorrectly applied the Dittus-Boelter correlation (for turbulent flow) to a laminar flow regime (Re=800). The agent repeated this error by explicitly stating, 'Use the Dittus–Boelter correlation: Nu = 0.023 Re^0.8 Pr^0.4'. The ground truth correctly replaces this with an appropriate laminar flow correlation.
